Gossip output chunk allocation and publish functions.

# Purpose
This header file declares the output-side interface for gossip packet construction. It defines the `fd_gossip_out_ctx` structure, which stores workspace and chunk state used to manage access to a data cache line. The file also declares [`fd_gossip_out_get_chunk`](<#fd_gossip_out_get_chunk>), which returns the next writable chunk, and [`fd_gossip_tx_publish_chunk`](<#fd_gossip_tx_publish_chunk>), which publishes a chunk after it has been filled. These functions are used together to prepare and send gossip data while keeping each write within the link MTU.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_gossip_out_get_chunk`
- `fd_gossip_tx_publish_chunk`
